title: NiceJob Pricing — Simple Plans, No Contracts

facts.fact: NiceJob's Starter plan is priced at $95 per month in USD.
NiceJob's Pro plan is priced at $135 per month in USD and includes everything in Starter plus Pro features.
facts.quote:
### Pro

$135

per month · USD

Built for businesses ready to do more with less effort.

facts.fact: NiceJob's pricing page states that its plans have no contracts.
NiceJob's Starter plan includes 6 features: Reviews, Social Proof, Social Sharing, Team Leaderboard, Microsite, and Integrations.
NiceJob's Pro tier lists 6 features: Repeats, Referrals, AI Replies, Broadcasts, NPS Surveys, and Competitive Intel.
NiceJob offers 2 standalone features, Sites and AI Leads, that can be bought without a plan.
NiceJob's Reviews feature is described by the vendor as helping businesses get 4x more reviews.
facts.quote: Get 4x more reviews and become a top-rated business.

facts.fact: NiceJob's Starter plan Reviews feature includes SMS and email review requests.
NiceJob's Sites add-on (a fully managed website) costs $99 per month in USD.
NiceJob's AI Leads add-on costs $99 per month in USD and is labeled Early Access on the page.
NiceJob's pricing page states that its plans have no contracts and can be cancelled at any time.
facts.quote: ✓No contracts✓Cancel anytime✓Free to start✓We help you get set up

facts.fact: NiceJob states that all plans listed on its pricing page are denominated in United States dollars (USD).
facts.quote: Yes, all plans listed on our pricing page are denominated in the United States dollar (USD).

facts.fact: NiceJob states customers are not locked into a contract at any time during their subscription plan.
facts.quote: No, you are not locked into a contract at any time during your NiceJob subscription plan.

facts.fact: NiceJob states that plan upgrades or downgrades between Starter and Pro take effect on the next billing cycle.
facts.quote: Upgrade from Starter to Pro (or back) at any time — changes take effect on your next billing cycle.

facts.fact: NiceJob states the billing date is the day the 14-day trial ends, or the sign-up date if the customer signs up after the trial ends.
facts.quote: Your billing date will be the day your 14-day trial ends or, if you sign up after the trial ends, on _that_ date.
we've even got a 14 day free trial to get you started

facts.fact: NiceJob states its Pro plan is its most popular plan.
facts.quote: Our most popular plan is the Pro plan, but the right fit totally depends on your business.

facts.fact: NiceJob lists Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Discover, JCB, Diners Club, China UnionPay, and debit cards as accepted payment methods.
facts.quote: We accept all major credit cards, including: Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Discover, JCB, Diners Club, China UnionPay, Debit cards.
